The cited theorem concerns a uniform infinite quadrangulation

statement: For a finite connected honeycomb lattice domain with zero values on boundary half-edges, the complex solution space of sum_{e incident to v}(m_e-v)F(m_e)=0 has dimension |E_internal|-|V|+1. In particular an interior regular hexagon of side delta supports the nonzero mode N(m_j)=delta/(v_{j+1}-v_j), zero elsewhere. This mode has sup norm 1 and adjacent jump 1 over distance sqrt(3)*delta/2, so the vertex identity plus boundedness and fixed boundary data does not imply uniqueness or equicontinuity uniform in the mesh.
assumptions: Finite connected internal graph
Every internal edge joins distinct vertices and has its geometric midpoint
All boundary half-edge values of N are zero
For the quantitative hexagon example the face is regular with side length delta>0
proof_or_counterexample: Invertible change X_e=(d_e/2)F(m_e) identifies the operator with a graph incidence matrix, of rank |V|-1 by a spanning tree. On the hexagon the two supported terms at each vertex are delta/2 and -delta/2. Full independent derivation saved before paired proof in INDEPENDENT_OBSTRUCTION.md.
remaining_gap: Independent referee check; establish a condition suppressing cycle modes for the actual normalized critical SAW observable. The constructed mode is not asserted to be a SAW path-sum.
verification_state: submitted proof; no independent check yet

statement: On C6 with adjacent endpoints and x>0, the positive-fugacity a-to-b SAW law gives the short edge probability 1/(1+x^4), whereas the uniform length-1 law gives it probability 1. Their total variation distance is x^4/(1+x^4), or 1/(7+4sqrt(2)) at x_c.
assumptions: Graph is exactly the six-cycle
Endpoints are adjacent
Positive fugacity x
Vertex-simple endpoint-conditioned paths
No scaling-limit inequivalence claimed
proof_or_counterexample: Exactly two simple paths exist, of lengths 1 and 5; divide weights x and x^5 by their sum. Conditional uniformity and a two-state mixture counterexample are proved separately in ENSEMBLE_GAP.md.
remaining_gap: Independent referee check; a scaling/endpoint transfer for the actual rooted fixed-n ensemble is unproved.
